newsitem.title: USA: Lakeland reports higher EPS, expects growth.
newsitem.headline: Lakeland reports higher EPS, expects growth.

text.p: Lakeland Industries Inc reported Thursday earnings per share rose to $0.18 from $0.16 in the quarter ending April 30 and said it expected accelerated growth in its industry depending on legislative developments.

If Congress passes pending legislation to increase federal government expenditures for the clean-up of Super Fund toxic waste sites later this year, growth in the overall protective clothing market could accelerate, the manufacturer and distributor of disposable and re-usable protective work clothing said in a statement."

For the three-month fiscal period ended April 30, the company's net sales increased 14 percent to about $12.0 million, versus $10.5 million in the first quarter of 1996. Net income rose 12.7 percent to $470,692 ($0.18 per share), compared with $417,825 ($0.16 per share) over the same period last year.

The company added several new industrial accounts to its customer base during the most recent quarter, said Lakeland's chief executive Raymond Smith in a statement. He added the company expanded production capacity outside of the United States.
